name: The Nile Festival
standfirst: An annual celebration of South Sudanese culture and identity.
blurb: The Nile Festival brings the platform off the page and into the open: a week of culture, sport, fashion, food and music, and the long-term engine that keeps the newsroom independent.

strands.name: Culture
strands.detail: Music, performance and the traditions carried between the states and the diaspora.

strands.name: Sport
strands.detail: Competition across the states, and the athletes who carry the country's name abroad.

strands.name: Fashion & textiles
strands.detail: Designers and makers working with South Sudanese cloth, pattern and form.

strands.name: Food
strands.detail: The cooking of the river and the regions, and the people who keep it.

strands.name: Entertainment
strands.detail: Screenings, live sessions and the closing concert.

awards.name: The Nile Festival Awards
awards.detail: Recognising work across the festival's strands, run through the foundation alongside the Nile Explorer Scholarships and the Nile Explorer Academy.
